events.title: Demo Update: Smoother Customers, New Sounds & Combat Improvements
events.summary: Hello, shopkeepers! We have made getting around your store easier, improved customer movement and expanded the game’s soundscape. Your broom can now help you defend yourself, too! Customers and the checkout queue Waiting customers step aside when you try to pass, if there is room, then return to their place in the queue. events.title: Demo Update: Livelier Customers, Better Combat & Save History
events.summary: Hello, shopkeepers! This demo update brings more life to your customers, better combat and more control over your saves. Manage your saves more easily The save browser has been redesigned. Find your markets by name and browse each market’s save history separately. Filter manual, automatic and quick saves, and check previews, the in-game day and your balance. Return to earlier points in your save history, name your saves and manage them. events.title: Demo v0.10: A Fresh Look, Howl FM & a Livelier Neighborhood
events.summary: Hello, shopkeepers! Demo v0.10 refreshes your shift from start to finish: redesigned screens, livelier streets, a smoother checkout, and your own music in the store. A new look for your store Redesigned the HUD, menus, WolficOS and many supporting screens. Made balance, sales streak, daily sales target, checkout queue and delivery information easier to follow. events.title: Demo Update: Card Payments, New Checkout Modes & More
events.summary: Hello, shopkeepers! Our latest demo update brings card payments, new checkout options, more ways to customize your controls, and improvements throughout your daily store routine. Checkout & Payments Customers can now pay by card! Enter the total on the POS terminal and complete the payment with a contactless tap. Keyboard and numpad entry are supported.
